basic_info.description: This contemporary Noe Valley residence, redesigned and remodeled by acclaimed architect John Lum,is a true masterpiece. Featuring three bedrooms, three baths, and two additional spacious multi-functional areas, every space unveils a delightful surprise. This sophisticated home showcases meticulous design through strategic interplay of windows, light and texture, delivering spectacular views of the city and the bay. The main level presents an open-concept living space with city views and a sleek gas fireplace, transitioning to an adjacent skylit dining area and a chef's kitchen with premium appliances. A guest suite, which may double as an office, fully completes this floor. Upstairs, discover the primary bedroom enveloped by luscious foliage creating a luxurious natural (treehouse-like) sanctuary. The lavish/chic en-suite features dual vanities, a free standing soaking tub, and waterfall shower. The show stopping fourth level solarium incorporates innovative suspended planters with integrated irrigation for plant lovers, opening to a stunning roof deck with spectacular sunrises and 180 views spanning San Francisco and the Bay. The garden level continues the indoor-outdoor lifestyle with a multi-functional room and a third en-suite bedroom, both accessing a private manicured yard.
